$comment: Hand-authored grouping of the grammar's node types for the Grammars tab. Guarded by dev/scripts/grammar-groups-check.py in nix flake check and by the page's runtime check. Type names are grammar TAGs (REQUIREMENT), never UID prefixes. A group's widget is "cards" (types: a list of TAGs, or the string "rest" for every TAG not placed elsewhere, at most once) or "grid" (axes: two lists of two words, cells: one TAG per [row, column] pair). The Definition axis words are DEC-NODE-FAMILIES' own: normative/descriptive, universal/particular. A group may carry a "glosses" map (TAG to one sentence) and a grid's axes a parallel "glosses" map (axis word to phrase); a gloss on a name the group does not place is a finding. The prose is copied verbatim from NAR-CANON-TYPES-GRID (the axis glosses) and the first sentence of each NAR-SEMANTIC-LAYER-TYPE-* narrative (the type glosses); a type with no narrative has no gloss. Interim hard-coding until the tab renders the narratives themselves, so the swap is mechanical.

glosses.NARRATIVE: A maintained projection for a reader: it presents parts of the canon, start to finish, and depends on their wording.
